text:
kevin: Quick question — we're seeing more client 429s when burst traffic hits per-route bucket. Should runtime return both Retry-After (secs) and X-RateLimit-Remaining/Reset for per-route 429s? We need compatibility with older SDKs that expect Retry-After only.

maria: Ideally both. UX: Retry-After for immediate backoff; X-RateLimit-* for dashboards. But watch payload size.

ben: For per-route buckets we currently send X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset plus body with `error.code: rate_limit`. Retry-After only when request is throttled due to global cooldown.

sara: If we add Retry-After on per-route 429s, older clients will respect it. New clients can use headers. :+1: 

kevin: ok — can we standardize units? Retry-After in seconds, Reset as epoch seconds? Some libs expect delta-seconds.

maria: We should send Retry-After as integer seconds AND X-RateLimit-Reset as epoch seconds. Example:

```
Retry-After: 15
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1672531200
```

ben: Also add X-RateLimit-Bucket: route-<hash> so clients can coalesce.

chip: What about bursts and 'soft' grace windows? Should we include header to indicate 'retry after bucket drains' vs 'global fallback used'?

sara: Add X-RateLimit-Reason maybe. Values: "route_burst", "global_fallback", "capacity_exhausted".

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: rate-limit-headers-std.toml -> canary to prod at 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC.

kevin: Cool. Follow-up: for canary, keep body shape stable: don't change top-level fields. We'll send sample error body:

```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded",
    "retry_after": 15,
    "metadata": {"bucket": "route-abc123", "reason":"route_burst"}
  }
}
```

maria: Agree. Avoid breaking SDKs that parse error.message or expect 'retry_after' to be number.

ben: I'll open a PR with header + body tests. ping @kevin for review.

kevin: Thanks. Also add a changelog note and migration guide for older SDKs.

sara: tl;dr: send Retry-After (seconds), X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset (epoch), X-RateLimit-Bucket, X-RateLimit-Reason, keep error body with retry_after and metadata.
